issues.failure_explanation: The Lagrangian of the stated primal (eq:linearminmax2) with multipliers w_j >= 0 is L = eta + sum_j w_j(|p(x_j)-f_j q(x_j)|^2 - eta |q(x_j)|^2) = eta(1 - sum_j w_j|q(x_j)|^2) + sum_j w_j|f_j q_j - p_j|, which is affine in the free variable eta. For the admissible pair (alpha, beta) = (0,0) (which satisfies the constraints for every eta), and more generally for any admissible pair rescaled by tau -> 0, the coefficient 1 - sum_j w_j|q(x_j)|^2 is nonzero, so the infimum of L over the primal domain is -inf: the true Lagrange dual function is identically -infinity, not the displayed d(w). The normalization sum_j w_j|q(x_j)|^2 = 1 in (eq:rat-d) is an additional gauge constraint that the invoked Lagrange duality theory does not produce (and the primal as displayed does not impose). Hence the claim that (eq:rat-d) is 'the Lagrange dual function' of the stated primal, and consequently that (eq:rat-dual) is 'the associated dual problem', is an invalid inference as written. (The same passage also displays the primal without the restrictions q(x_j) != 0 / (alpha,beta) not both zero, under which its infimum is -infinity rather than the squared minimax value.)

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Present (eq:rat-d) as a definition of the dual function and justify its lower-bound property directly by the scaling argument the paper already uses in the proof of Theorem thm:q-dual (scale the feasible pair so that sum_j w_j|q(x_j)|^2 = 1); or, equivalently, add the gauge constraint sum_j w_j|q(x_j)|^2 = 1 to the displayed primal, legitimate by the scale-invariance of max_j |p/q - f_j| under (p,q) -> tau(p,q), and redo the Lagrangian step on the normalized primal. Either repair is short and local; all subsequent results are unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The paper's central object, the dual problem (eq:rat-dual) with dual function d(w), is not derived from the primal by the Lagrange duality argument given; its status as 'the Lagrange dual function' is unsupported. No labelled downstream result is invalidated: weak duality is re-proved directly by the scaling argument in the proof of Theorem thm:q-dual, strong duality and Theorem thm:extremep are proved directly for the displayed d(w), and Lemma lem:KKT, Proposition prop:dual_GEP and Algorithm alg:bdLawson only use d(w) as defined. The defect is confined to the derivation narrative of Section 3.
issues.title: Lagrange-dual derivation of the dual function d(w) is invalid: the Lagrangian dual of the stated primal is identically -infinity
issues.why_classification: The repair is a short, local, routine fix (state the gauge normalization for the displayed primal, or present (eq:rat-d) as a definition justified by the two-line scaling bound already given in the proof of Theorem thm:q-dual). Every substantive claim and guarantee survives: the dual function d(w), the dual problem, weak duality, strong duality, the extreme-point bound and the algorithm are all proved directly for the displayed d(w), so no result, rate, or advertised scope is lost.
